units.source_text: 玉鬘尚未过惯宫廷生活。

en.t: Tamakazura was still not used to life at court.

units.source_text: 但照这短短的时日说来，她的进步实在很快：

en.t: But considering how short a time it had been, her progress was truly rapid:

units.source_text: 院内一切布置，都富有风趣，童女的服装也很优雅。

en.t: Everything in the residence was arranged with taste, and the young attendants' clothing was also very elegant.

units.source_text: 侍女众多，室内装饰大致楚楚。

en.t: There were many serving women, and the interior decorations were generally neat and graceful.

units.source_text: 但各种细致设备，尚未十分完全。

en.t: But the various finer furnishings were not yet fully complete.

units.source_text: 总之，她的宅院精小可爱。

en.t: In short, her residence was small, refined, and charming.

units.source_text: 玉鬘本人呢，本来令人一看就惊叹为美人，

en.t: As for Tamakazura herself, she was already the kind of beauty who made people marvel at first sight,

units.source_text: 今天穿了源氏所赠的棣棠色春服，更加显得如花如玉。

en.t: and today, wearing the kerria-yellow spring robes Genji had given her, she looked even more flowerlike and radiant.

units.source_text: 周身浓纤适度，绝无瑕疵可指，真教人百看不厌。

en.t: Her whole figure was perfectly proportioned, with no flaw to point out, and one could truly never tire of looking at her.

units.source_text: 只因长年沉沦乡间，郁郁寡欢，以致头发末端稍稀。

en.t: Only because she had spent long years buried in the countryside, melancholy and unhappy, the ends of her hair had become slightly thin.

units.source_text: 然而疏疏朗朗地披散在衣服上，倒也十分美观。

en.t: Yet as it fell loosely and lightly over her robes, it was still very beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏看见她长得十全其美，心念此人如果不住在六条院，真太可惜了。

en.t: Seeing that she had grown into such flawless beauty, Genji thought it would be a great pity if someone like her did not live at Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 便觉得仅乎把她当作女儿看待，有些儿不满足。

en.t: He therefore felt somewhat unsatisfied with treating her merely as a daughter.

units.source_text: 玉鬘虽然对源氏已甚熟悉，但念此人到底不是生身父亲，不免多所顾忌。

en.t: Although Tamakazura had already become very familiar with Genji, remembering that he was not her real father after all, she could not help feeling many reservations.

units.source_text: 她常常觉得这关系很奇怪，犹如做梦一般，因此不敢放心亲近他。

en.t: She often felt this relationship was strange, as if it were a dream, and so she did not dare draw close to him without caution.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得这态度也很可爱。

en.t: Genji found this attitude charming too.

units.source_text: 对她言道：“你来到这里虽然不久，我似觉已经多年了，

en.t: He said to her, "Although it has not been long since you came here, to me it feels as though many years have already passed,

units.source_text: 见面时毫无生疏之感，但觉十分称心如意。

en.t: and when we meet I feel no strangeness at all, only a deep sense of satisfaction.

units.source_text: 所以你也不须顾忌，常常到我们那边去玩。

en.t: So you need not hold back either; come often to our side to visit and amuse yourself.

units.source_text: 那边的小妹妹正在初学弹琴，你可和她一起学习。

en.t: The little girl over there is just beginning to learn the koto, and you may study together with her.

units.source_text: 对那边的人都不须客气。”

en.t: There is no need to be formal with anyone over there."

units.source_text: 玉鬘答道：“女儿自当遵命。”

en.t: Tamakazura replied, "Your daughter will of course obey."

units.source_text: 这应对也很恰当。

en.t: This response too was very proper.
